title: Editorial Package
description: DC-003-I031 — the canonical strategic representation of one approved article, derived from exactly one immutable Ingested Content record (DC-003-I030) via AI-assisted editorial analysis. Every later content-generation milestone (Social Media Package, Production Assets, Publishing) consumes this object, never the original article or the Ingested Content record directly. Immutable after creation: no update path exists; at most one Editorial Package may exist per ingested_content_id (see the Editorial Package Store's own duplicate-rejection rule).

editorial_package_id.description: Machine-generated, independent of ingested_content_id — mirrors every other DC-003 identifier convention (ic_/wo_/req_/...).

ingested_content_id.description: The single, required input this package was derived from (DC-003-I030's Ingested Content Store). At most one Editorial Package may exist per ingested_content_id — see editorial-package-store.mjs's own findByIngestedContentId().

status.description: "generated" is the only value DC-003-I031 itself ever produces — a failed generation never persists a record at all (see README "Validation"). Deliberately left open for a later milestone's own downstream lifecycle stages (e.g. editorial approval), mirroring ingested-content.schema.json's own identical status-field rationale.

generated_at.description: When the analysis was performed — mirrors finished-carousel.schema.json/carousel-content's own generated_at naming for an AI-generated artifact, not created_at/updated_at (Ingested Content's own naming, for a retrieval event instead of a generation event — see README for the distinction).

llm_model.description: The provider/model identifier that produced this package (e.g. "mock-editorial-analysis-provider-v1" or "anthropic-claude-sonnet-5") — mirrors carousel-content.schema.json's own llm_model provenance field.

checksum.description: SHA-256 hex digest of every other field on this record (tamper-evidence for the record itself), computed by createEditorialPackage() immediately before the record is frozen — mirrors ingested-content.schema.json's own checksum field exactly.
